Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of the organizational relationship between the Atlanta-based franchise and the New York-based franchises. The Planner incorrectly concluded that "New York City FC and New York Red Bulls" are "franchises of the pro soccer organization headquartered in Atlanta." In reality, Atlanta United FC, New York City FC, and New York Red Bulls are all separate, independent franchises within the same league (MLS). They do not share a parent organization or franchise relationship. The Planner failed to distinguish between being in the same league and being part of the same franchise organization, leading to a logically invalid final answer.
